messages:
Kai PM: Heads up 11 11 we have three pilot customers asking for tiered SLA activation tied to feature toggles + audit/KMS guarantees. They want a path to 99.99% but with staged milestones. Can product/eng ops propose an activation rubric for GA?
Jun Eng: high level: we can do staged activation per customer: Stage A (pilot) = 99.9, Stage B (ramp) = 99.95, Stage C (full) = 99.99. Each stage requires passing a set of gates: perf, stability, security (KMS proofs), and docs/legal signoff.
Lina SRE: ops gates I'd require for each stage:
- Capacity soak (72h) with synthetic traffic matching peak distributions
- No Sev1 incidents for 14 days
- Observability: presence of customer-scoped golden metrics and dashboard
- Audit logs verification (delivery + retention)
Also need a rollback playbook keyed to route toggles.
Tom Sales: customers prefer a calendar-based ramp too (e.g., "activate full SLA 30d after Stage C pass"). Pricing negotiation: they ask for credit caps (e.g., max 3 months credits) not open-ended exposure.
Priya Legal: legal needs explicit measurement windows and an algorithm for credit calculation. Also need a clause for forced maintenance and scheduled downtime carve-outs.
Helga Docs: gaps: no public "tiered SLA" doc. I'll draft a customer-facing explainer + an internal activation checklist that maps to the product gates. ETA 4 days for first pass.
Jun Eng: implementation notes 11: routing toggle + per-customer config. propose route config example:
```
customer_config:
  tiered_sla: true
  stage: B            # A/B/C
  stage_activation_date: 2026-04-05
  burst_slots: 20
  credit_cap_months: 3
  measurement_window: rolling_30d
```
Jun Eng: also plan a small feature in the control-plane UI to show current stage + activation history.
Lina SRE: monitoring pieces: add labels to metrics with customer_id; ship dashboards in Console with these panels: latency_p50/p95/p99, qps, cpu_gpu_util, kv_warm_rate, audit_ingest_lag. Add alerts: sustained p99 > 200ms for 10m or audit_ingest_lag > 30s.
Kai PM: product proposal for GA activation policy:
- Required for Stage B -> capacity soak 72h, CI chaos pass, runbook in repo, legal signed SLA template
- Required for Stage C (99.99) -> 30d stable post-Stage B, additional KV prewarm guarantees, dedicated burst reservation test, and SLA credits unlocked
- Billing credits: formula = min( (downtime_seconds / measurement_window_seconds) * monthly_payment, credit_cap ) with a hard cap negotiated per contract.
Tom Sales: can we offer a "pilot credit holdback" for Stage A11? e.g., hold credits until Stage B pass to reduce our risk. Customers push back but accept as transitional language.
Priya Legal: carve-outs: scheduled_maintenance, customer_misuse, third_party_outage. Also need to define the authority that flips stage toggles (product + infra ops approval).
Helga Docs: will include an activation checklist with owner columns: Eng (jun), SRE (lina), Legal (pri), Sales (tom), Docs (helga).
Jun Eng: engineering estimate: toggle + per-customer metrics tagging + UI flag ~ 2 sprints. KV prewarm and reservation tests another 2 sprints if we want deterministic slot guarantees.
Lina SRE: ops work: create a capacity harness job in CI that can run a customer's traffic shape on demand; automate the soak harness + results upload to Console. ETA 10 days to wire up.
infra-bot: Ticket PROD-14221 created: "Tiered SLA onramp: metrics tagging + activation UI + capacity harness" 11 assignees: @Jun Eng, @Lina SRE.
Kai PM: Decision biases / GA rule: we will not promise 99.99% at GA unless at least one pilot has completed Stage C and we have automation for the soak + alerting in place. Otherwise offer up to 99.95% with staged upgrade path.
Tom Sales: noted. I'll present staged offer to pilots and include credit cap language.
Priya Legal: I'll draft SLA appendix templates and maintenance carve-outs; will share in 48h.
Helga Docs: will post the activation checklist PR once legal text lands.
Jun Eng: starting the metrics tagging PR today, will reference PROD-14221.
Lina SRE: schedule first harness run for next Wed; will attach results.
Kai PM: great. check-in next Tue morning. If anyone hits blockers call me out. :bell:
